src: Moorhead Daily News, 15 Oct 1925, p. 1 (UP; Newspapers.com 1191843246), '40 Barrels of Beer in Earth'; wire ran 19-29 Oct 1925
tw-mn-henderson-ritter-beer-casks.st: The dates: in Oct 1925 the UP reported two huge oak casks buried about 60 years earlier in a hillside tunnel at Joseph Ritter's brewery, after Charles Ney razed the brewery that summer; in May 1926 four men were digging 30 ft down with a chart from old brewery employees, and the Volstead officers were asked for a ruling.
